body: Assuming we get to discuss #8759 tomorrow, could @mozfreddyb and @otherdaniel be added to the meeting invite?
Confirming that both are now in the invite.

We had a larger crew today, thank you all for attending and for the lively discussion! Here are the notes from this meeting (the next one is at https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8873):

### Agenda

1. Review past action items
    1. Mason/Joey will take a look at [Details and summary styles don't match implementations](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8610). Emilio will send a spec PR to match implementations. Will use prose for anonymous summary for now.
        1. Done.
    1. Anne will review the [Popover API proposal](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/8717).
        1. Done.
    1. Olli will suggest some changes on the [Session history entries list is assumed to be unlimited in size](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8620) issue, Domenic can help to get them written up into a spec PR if necessary. Anne to check if WebKit has any opinions.
        1. Olli: this is a longer term task. The spec algorithms will need changes and need to test first all the implementations.  Panos will take it off the agenda for now, while Olli investigates.
    1. Domenic and Anne will work out the new example text for [Implement dialog initial focus proposal](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/8199).
        1. Done.
    1. Domenic will check with the V8 team on their opinion on ["is import assertions a bad name?" and "are we OK changing the syntax?"](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7233).
        1. Done. TC39 demoted assertions in the last meeting.
1. Carryovers from last time
    1. [Anne] [Align with DOM DocumentFragment adoption changes](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/5413)
        1. Will bring it back once there is progress to discuss.
    1. [Domenic] [`<input type="time">` : Time vs. duration](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/5488)
        1. Will discuss it next time when Domenic is present.
1. New topics
    1. [Chris] [Add convenient, ergonomic, performant API for sorting siblings](https://github.com/whatwg/dom/issues/586)
        1. Chris will summarize the discussion and the agreed upon next steps.
    1. [Mason] [Add DOMParser option to parse declarative shadow DOM](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8759)
        1. Will discuss it next time.
    1. [Anne] [JavaScript ShadowRealm proposal integration](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/5339)
        1. This is scheduled for the 2/23 call.

### Action Items

1. @chrishtr will summarize the discussion around [Add convenient, ergonomic, performant API for sorting siblings](https://github.com/whatwg/dom/issues/586) and the agreed upon next steps.
